prompt:

Must preserve state signals: paywall subscription selection, monthly/quarterly/annual cards, recommended quarterly, benefits, payment guide, select buttons, manage/back actions, payment not completed.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, colorful CTAs, loud marketing gradient, decorative subscription art, huge radii, card shadow abuse.
